title: Scalable Frame-based Construction of Sociocultural NormBases for Socially-Aware Dialogues
reasoning: The paper focuses on the automated extraction and construction of sociocultural norm bases (etiquette, social conventions, and cultural taboos) to improve socially-aware dialogue systems. While it touches on 'social and moral norms' as categories for extraction, its primary focus is on the engineering pipeline and the utility of the resulting database for NLP tasks, rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, theology, or formal ethical frameworks.
